sourceCheckpoint: 24232b1 plus uncommitted explicit-index candidate and diagnostic tooling

failure.limitation: The diagnostic reported matching JSON, but did not capture the two typed start operands. This is evidence for further tracing, not proof of an optimizer defect. The original successful source measurement and failed replay are retained unchanged, with hash-verified exact assets.

tierComparison.observedOptionOutput: Playwright browser process logs reported useFTLJIT=false (default: true) in each of ten fresh processes, four modified-option blocks per process.
tierComparison.runtimeVerificationBoundary: The replay report itself deliberately leaves tierOverrideEffectVerified false; option-output evidence was observed externally and does not prove which tier executed a specific comparison.
tierComparison.conclusion: A bounded diagnostic pass only. The same bundle previously passed 900 normal cases before its exact normal replay failed. Passing with the FTL option disabled does not establish causality, fix the library, qualify performance or provide a deployable workaround.

normalTypedOperandRun.interpretation: Nested layout admission returned null before the new block-index or start-comparison traces were reached. No typed operands from those sites were observed. The explicit-index candidate remains incomplete.

nextExperiment.kind: explicit bounded uninstrumented WebKit owner churn
nextExperiment.transformation: Only the fixture owner-loop bound changes; installed browser and Wasm code is not transformed. Module transform-count assertions enforce this. Correctness assertions remain intact; timings are not release qualification.
nextExperiment.interpretation: All 900 cases passed without diagnostics. Bounded success does not supersede earlier retained failures of the same candidate package pair.

nestedLayoutTracing.coverage: Sixteen explicit null/false rejection sites plus final node coverage; stage and local primitive values captured only on failure, without generated metadata rereads or validation retries.
nestedLayoutTracing.regression: Real compiled adapter function returned identical results and generated-method call sequences before/after transformation across valid and malformed fixtures, with normal and throwing loggers. Structural anchors reject changed or duplicate rejection sites.
nestedLayoutTracing.boundary: Instrumentation can affect recurrence. This bounded pass does not resolve or supersede retained candidate failures.
